text:
sophie: Heads-up: quick sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to confirm marketplace launch playbook. Need clear owners for press, SI handoffs, and CDN cutover.

kevin: I'll own the landing and CDN purge steps. Need final partner SVGs in assets by Thu 3pm PT.

ajay: SI onboarding smoke tests look good. One SSO rotation flake noted (ticket INF-3301). I'll add short sample terraform and webhook examples to the repo.

maria: Press embargo from partners is 2026-06-09T16:00Z. Legal asked to vet all quotes by EOD Thu. I can coordinate but need a backup for publish.

olivia: I can be backup for press publish and will draft the partner FAQ + social kit. Propose a shared sheet for blurbs + logo files.

ops-bot: Reminder: staging->prod cutover window 2026-06-09T17:00Z. Auto-deploy pause scheduled 30m prior. Manual approval required.

sophie: Great. Quick checklist for tomorrow: press embargo alignment, final assets + logo fallbacks, SI onboarding repo link, CDN TTLs & purge command, emergency rollback text. Bring blockers.

kevin: Adding CDN purge command to runbook: `curl -X POST https://cdn.internal/purge -H "Authorization: Bearer $CDN" -d '{"paths":["/partners/*"]}'`. Also fallback: generic partner band if asset 404.

ajay: Repo: github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-samples/si-onboard. Container used: gcr.io/redwood/si-helper:v1.2. I'll push README and terraform snippets.

maria: I'll chase legal on quote redlines. If not signed by EOD Thu, we revert to generic quote. Olivia will handle publish.

sophie: Assigning owners: Kevin (landing + CDN), Ajay (SI + repo), Maria (press signoff), Olivia (backup publish + FAQ). See you at the sync. :white_check_mark:
